Legacy rate card
Most new and existing customers across all plans have been migrated to the new token-based pricing, and should use the new rate card listed in this page.
A small subset of Enterprise customers should continue using the legacy rate card until we migrate you to the new token-based pricing for Codex. For more information, contact OpenAI sales .

The legacy rate card expresses Codex usage as approximate average credits per message or pull request. These averages are useful for rough planning, but actual credit usage can vary based on task size, model choice, and reasoning requirements.
Why are there two Codex rate cards?

We have modified our pricing from credits per message to credits per token type consumed. OpenAI supports both the legacy rate card and the updated token-based rate card. The applicable version depends on workspace migration status.
Which rate card should I use?

Most new and existing Plus, Pro, ChatGPT Business, Enterprise, Health, Edu, and Gov customers should use the token-based pricing rate card . A small set of Enterprise customers should continue using the legacy rate card . If you are an Enterprise customer and have questions, contact OpenAI Sales .
What changed in the updated token-based rate card?
The legacy rate card shows approximate average credits per message or pull request. The updated token-based rate card shows credits by token type.
Why is the rate card being changed?

Credits remain the core pricing unit that customers purchase and consume. The updated token-based format makes credit usage easier to map to actual model activity, aligns Codex pricing more closely with token-based metering, and gives clearer visibility into how input, cached input, and output contribute to total usage.
How does this affect my pricing?

The impact depends on your workload mix. Some users may see higher credit consumption, while others may see lower credit consumption, depending on how much input, cached input, and output their tasks use. Output-heavy tasks and fast mode generally consume more credits than lighter tasks.
Codex referral promotions: ChatGPT Desktop Referral Promotions
Terms for ChatGPT Desktop referral offers
Promotion Overview

Eligible users may see an in-product ChatGPT Desktop referral offer. Depending on the offer, eligible users may be able to invite another person to try ChatGPT Desktop and receive a promotional benefit after the invited person completes the required action. Referral benefits may include usage credits, a rate-limit reset, temporary additional usage, or another benefit described in the offer. The exact benefit, eligible experience, cap, expiration, and redemption requirements may vary by plan, workspace, region, and promotion. Rewards are not granted when an invite is sent. Referral promotions have not been disabled by a workspace admin.
An eligible ChatGPT plan or workspace as described in the offer.
Prior ChatGPT Desktop activity or an eligible usage, credit, or rate-limit event described in the offer.
Remaining within any referral caps, cooldowns, or redemption limits described in the offer.

Duplicate redemptions, self-invites, address aliases used to evade eligibility, device-linked self-referrals, and other suspected fraudulent or abusive activity are not eligible.

How do ChatGPT Desktop referral promotions work?

Benefits vary by offer. They may include usage credits, a rate-limit reset, temporary additional usage, or another promotional benefit described in the offer. Rate-limit resets apply only to ChatGPT Work or Codex, as specified in the offer.
How do I activate a referral reward?

The invited person must accept the referral invite and complete the qualifying action described in the offer using ChatGPT Desktop. If the offer is tied to a ChatGPT Business workspace, the invited person may also need to join that workspace. Rewards are applied after those steps and any eligibility checks are complete.
Referral caps, cooldowns, and redemption limits vary by offer and are shown in the applicable offer. Some offers may limit the number of rewards per person, workspace, subscription, or time period.
Can existing ChatGPT Business workspaces participate in workspace-specific referrals?
Yes, if the workspace and users meet the offer's eligibility requirements, the workspace is in good standing, and referral promotions have not been disabled by a workspace admin.
What if the same person receives multiple referral invites?
Only the first qualifying referral invite can count toward reward redemption. Duplicate invites do not create additional rewards.
The reward may still be granted if the referral remains within any applicable redemption period and all other eligibility requirements are met.
Are referral credits API credits?
No, unless the offer explicitly says otherwise. Credits issued under these promotions are generally for the eligible experience described in the offer.
Are rate-limit resets credits?
No. Rate-limit resets and temporary usage windows are not credits and do not create a cash, API, or transferable credit balance.
Can workspace admins turn referral promotions off?

ChatGPT Business workspace admins may disable referral promotions for their workspace. If disabled, eligible users should not see workspace referral offers and new workspace referral rewards will not be granted.
Do referral rewards expire?

Referral rewards may expire as described in the referral offer or applicable terms. For offers that grant a banked rate-limit reset, the reset applies only to ChatGPT Work or Codex, as described in the offer, and must be used within 30 days after it is added to your bank, unless the offer says otherwise. Check the offer for expiration and redemption details.
Can OpenAI end or change these promotions?

OpenAI may modify or wind down referral promotions with at least 30 days' notice. OpenAI may also revoke or cancel rewards sooner in cases of suspected misuse, fraud, or other violations, in compliance with law, or as permitted under applicable terms.
Can I transfer or sell a referral offer?
No. Referral offers are intended only for eligible users and eligible invitees. They may not be transferred, sold, or exchanged.
Flexible usage credits: Using Credits for Flexible Usage in ChatGPT (Free/Go/Plus/Pro)
Key information and FAQs about using credits
Credits extend usage for supported features after included plan limits are reached. The supported feature set can change; the usage page and rate card show the options available to your plan.

We're adding the ability for you to purchase credits when you reach your plan's included limits, without the need to upgrade your plan. Credits currently can only be used with Codex (for Plus/Pro users only) and ChatGPT for Excel .
What changes for my plan
Nothing about your plan changes. You still get your plan's included usage.
Credits are a pay-as-you-go add-on for supported features when you need more usage beyond plan limits.
Flexible pricing availability varies by feature and plan. Check the usage page for what is available to your account.
How credits work

Your plan's included usage is used first. After you hit plan limits, usage draws from your credit balance. Read about Codex usage limits . For Plus and Pro, supported agentic features, including Codex, ChatGPT Work, and ChatGPT for Excel, can draw from the same agentic usage allowance. If you hit a usage limit in Codex on Plus or Pro, you'll see an option to add credits. You can also buy credits from Codex Settings > Usage > Credits on both web and the Codex app. Eligible Plus and Pro users can also turn on Auto top-up from Codex Settings > Usage . When your credit balance drops below your selected minimum balance, we automatically purchase only the amount needed to return it to your selecte

If a task starts while your balance is positive but finishes after concurrent usage depletes it, your balance can go negative. In that case, later credit purchases or auto top-ups may first offset the negative balance before increasing your available credits. Check Codex Settings > Usage Dashboard for your current balance and recent usage.
For Codex rates, refer to the Codex rate card .
A typical ChatGPT for Excel/Sheets task using GPT-5.5 may consume between 5 and 20 credits per message.
A typical ChatGPT for PowerPoint task using GPT-5.5 may consume between 10 and 50 credits per message.
Can I use the same credits for different features?

Yes. Credits work across supported features available to your plan, which can include Codex, ChatGPT Work, and ChatGPT for Excel. For example, credits added through Codex can be used by other supported features on the same eligible account after included limits are reached.
Can I use auto top-up with credits?

Eligible Plus and Pro users can turn on auto top-up from Codex Settings > Usage Dashboard . When your credit balance drops below your selected minimum balance, we automatically purchase enough credits to return it to your selected target balance, up to any maximum monthly spend you set, using your default payment method on file. If your balance is already below the minimum when you turn it on, a purchase may happen right away.
Are credits refundable?
Credits are non-refundable, except where required by law. We may restore credits in cases of confirmed account compromise (see below).
Do credits expire or roll over?
Credits are valid for 12 months from purchase. Unused credits expire and do not roll over after the expiry date.
What happens if credits are used due to a compromised account?

If your account is compromised and credits are used without authorization, report the incident immediately using the Unauthorized Activity webform and contact OpenAI Support using the chat bubble in the bottom-right corner of this page . We will investigate the incident, restore lost credits if misuse is confirmed, and assist with password resets and security controls. We also recommend that you take immediate steps to secure the account by following the steps outlined here: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/7242626-how-can-i-report-fraud-or-suspicious-activity
Are credits transferable?
Credits are non-transferable, have no cash value, and cannot be resold or gifted.
What terms govern the purchase of credits?
Credits are subject to the above and the Service credit terms: https://openai.com/policies/service-credit-terms/

Do ChatGPT related rate limits for file upload limits, image limits and voice caps apply to Codex?

ChatGPT file uploads, image generation, or voice have separate usage limits, reset periods, and banners. For example, if you see banners like “50 images in the last day”, “resets in 720 hours”, reach voice caps, or see upload-limit banners while uploading files in ChatGPT, those limits do not apply to Codex. For details on image and video limits and voice limits, see image & video generation limits and voice usage limits . For information about ChatGPT file upload limits and troubleshooting, see File Uploads FAQ . How do Codex referral invitations and banked resets work?

Eligible users may see Codex referral invitations in the profile menu. Personal plan users may see Invite a friend , and eligible Business workspace members may see Invite a coworker . The invitation dialog shows details for the current offer, such as the current reward, invite limits, expiration, and any recipient requirements that apply.

For some Plus and Pro promotions, a successful referral can add a banked Codex rate-limit reset. To use a banked reset, open the profile menu and select the usage summary showing the available reset count, such as 1 reset available .
Referral rewards vary by offer and plan. For current reward, limit, and eligibility details, see Invite friends and coworkers and Codex Referral Promotions .
What happens if I reach a usage limit while Codex is working?

If you reach a usage limit during an active turn, Codex can continue working on that turn, subject to fair-use limits. After that turn, check the Codex usage page or the limit banner for the options available on your plan, such as adding credits, applying an available reset, upgrading, or waiting for the limit to reset.
